subject.title: [Feature]: Audit log for agent memory changes

question: What memory mutation audit contract should OpenClaw support for `MEMORY.md` and `memory/*.md` writes, including storage location, integrity model, redaction policy, and cause propagation?
rationale: The security value depends on tamper boundaries, privacy tradeoffs, storage ownership, and whether the audit belongs in memory-core, a plugin SDK seam, or an external integration, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Design first-class memory audit
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify storage, integrity, redaction, event schema, and cause propagation before accepting implementation.

options.title: Fold into provenance architecture
options.body: Track implementation under the durable persistence and provenance issues if maintainers want one architecture for memory, files, preferences, and tasks.

options.title: Externalize after API review
options.body: Narrow or close core work only if maintainers decide existing plugin or MCP surfaces are sufficient without new OpenClaw contracts.

recommendation.title: Design first-class memory audit
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify storage, integrity, redaction, event schema, and cause propagation before accepting implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already routed this issue as memory/security design and is the strongest current product/security owner signal in the discussion.
